ios.notes:
The real iOS 26 tab bar, glass opacity you can set, and a tidier mini player.

Duotone for iPhone 7.3.2

New
- Liquid Glass: the tabs are now the system tab bar, so you can hold the selected tab and drag the glass lens from tab to tab.
- Customise: a Glass opacity slider under Liquid Glass, from clear glass to a dark capsule.
- Up next: an X on the "Back to …" row hides it.

Improved
- Liquid Glass: the mini player capsule is now smaller than the tab bar, and its artwork has rounded corners and sits centred.

Fixed
- The mini player artwork had almost square corners; they are rounded again.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.3.1...ios-v7.3.2

windows.notes:
A cleaner typeface for numbers and labels, and a way to dismiss "Back to".

Duotone for Windows 7.3.2

New
- Up next: an X on the "Back to …" row hides it.

Improved
- Numbers and small labels (durations, counts, "Next · 81 songs", "Library") use the same typeface as the rest of the app, with figures that line up in columns. The monospaced font is gone.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.2.8...win-v7.3.2

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
